SELECT run_id, user_id, rating, reason, note, version, created_at, updated_at FROM answer_feedback WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_feedback (run_id, user_id, rating, reason, note, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{runId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{reason}, #{note}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE answer_feedback SET rating = #{rating}, reason = #{reason}, note = #{note}, version = version + 1, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, deleted_at = NULL WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_feedback WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT rating AS category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM answer_feedback WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY rating
